body:
## Code Review

This pull request replaces the legacy AWK-based nesting-depth scanner with a more robust implementation using shfmt and a Python AST walker. This change eliminates several false-positive classes, such as elif inflation and keywords within strings or heredocs, and introduces per-function depth calculation. The PR also includes a new test suite, updated documentation, and a graceful fallback to AWK. A review comment suggests improving error handling in the Python script to ensure that AST walking failures are reported rather than silently ignored.

## Code Review

This pull request replaces the legacy AWK-based nesting-depth scanner with a more robust AST walker using `shfmt --to-json` and `jq`. This change resolves several long-standing false-positive issues, such as incorrect counting of `elif` chains, prose keywords, and heredoc contents, while also implementing per-function depth resets. The PR includes the new scanner script, updates to the complexity regression helper, documentation updates, and a comprehensive test suite. I have provided feedback regarding the fragility of the help text extraction logic in the new scanner script.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a mechanism to opt-out of the interactive PR handover process by honoring a 'no-takeover' label. Specifically, the _interactive_pr_is_stale function in pulse-merge-conflict.sh now checks for this label and skips the handover if present. Corresponding unit tests have been added to verify this behavior. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a robust PID liveness check mechanism to address PID reuse issues, particularly on macOS. It adds `_is_process_alive_and_matches` and `_compute_argv_hash` to `shared-constants.sh`, allowing scripts to verify a process's identity via command-line patterns and hashes rather than relying solely on `kill -0`. Numerous helper scripts have been updated to use these new checks for safer lock acquisition and stale process cleanup. A comprehensive regression test has also been included. Review feedback suggests improving error handling by propagating exit codes instead of masking them with a default return and optimizing performance by reducing redundant `ps` calls.

## Code Review

This pull request implements a defensive guard in routine-schedule-helper.sh to identify and reject regex metacharacters within schedule expressions, preventing errors where patterns are incorrectly passed as schedules. It also adds a warning for escaped asterisks in cron expressions and updates the test suite with new regression cases. Review feedback suggests including backticks in the metacharacter filter for more comprehensive protection and identifies that the new cron warning is unreachable because the defensive guard triggers first on the backslash character.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new legal research subagent and associated documentation for handling legal document corpora like contracts and case law. The changes include updates to the agent index and domain references. Feedback focuses on correcting non-standard file paths to ensure compatibility with framework tools, replacing hardcoded absolute paths with relative markdown links for better navigation, and correcting the spelling of trademarked legal terms.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces worker success rate tracking to the health dashboard by adding functions to compute and format success rates based on GitHub PR states and local execution metrics. The feedback focuses on improving efficiency: specifically, combining multiple GitHub API calls into a single paginated request per repository and refactoring the computation logic to avoid redundant I/O when processing overlapping time windows (24h and 7d).

## Code Review

This pull request introduces batch prefetching and rate-limit probing to the issue enrichment process to reduce GitHub API calls, along with a new regression test suite. Feedback suggests adopting the project's standard cleanup pattern for temporary files to ensure robust resource management and recommends optimizing the jq lookup within the enrichment loop to avoid O(N x M) complexity.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the `legal-research.md` documentation by standardizing file paths, correcting the spelling of "Shepardizing", and adding markdown links for various tools. The feedback suggests improving the link text for the OCR tool for consistency and ensuring the spelling correction is applied throughout the document.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a batch processing mode to the nesting depth scanner, enabling parallel file analysis via background jobs to significantly reduce scan times. It also updates the nesting depth threshold configuration from 290 to 10, reflecting the improved accuracy of the new AST-based scanner. The review feedback suggests enhancing the shell script's robustness by adopting the project's standard cleanup pattern for temporary directories and improving efficiency by using Bash arrays instead of temporary files for path storage to minimize redundant I/O operations.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces performance optimizations for pre-push hooks by implementing fast-paths for documentation-only changes. The complexity and privacy guards now skip intensive scans when irrelevant files are modified. Additionally, the full-loop helper script now includes a 60-second timeout for git pushes to prevent hangs and a new `--skip-hooks` flag for manual bypass. Feedback was provided to improve the robustness of the privacy guard by using local SHAs instead of HEAD, implementing dynamic default branch detection, and adhering to shell scripting best practices regarding variable declarations and error suppression.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces an auto-decomposer system designed to prevent parent-task issues from becoming dispatch black holes when they lack child tasks. Key changes include a new daily scanner script, a 7-day escalation lifecycle in the reconciler, and synchronous warnings for missing decomposition markers. The review feedback provides actionable improvements for hardening GitHub API interactions via pagination and refining regex patterns for better portability and precision in child detection logic.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new section on Advanced Retrieval Patterns to the vector search documentation, detailing agentic retrieval and multivector models for visual documents. Feedback was provided regarding a discrepancy in the number of sub-queries described in an example and mathematical inconsistencies in the storage cost comparisons between ColBERT and Muvera compression.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces wall-clock and network timeouts to the task ID claiming script to prevent indefinite hangs during concurrent operations, and ensures offline claims are committed locally to maintain a clean working tree. A new regression test suite is also added. The review feedback identifies that the proposed network timeouts using environment variables are ineffective and should be replaced with Git configuration flags. Additionally, it suggests making the local commit process in offline mode more robust and updating the tests to align with these corrections.

## Code Review

This pull request implements an audit trail for operator-facing bypass flags across several helper scripts, ensuring that every bypass is logged for accountability. It introduces a comprehensive reference document (`override-flags.md`) and a new regression test suite (`test-override-flags.sh`) to verify logging behavior and safety floors. Feedback focuses on improving test isolation by stubbing project root and repository detection, and correcting test logic where `pass` was incorrectly used instead of `fail` in failure branches.

## Code Review

This pull request implements a structured local audit log for destructive GitHub operations, including a logging helper, an anomaly scanner, and integration into existing GitHub CLI wrappers. The review feedback highlights several performance and observability improvements, such as addressing network latency caused by synchronous state fetching, optimizing shell script efficiency by consolidating multiple jq invocations into single passes, and ensuring better debuggability by avoiding the suppression of error output in critical commands.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the preflight daily scans by removing the `_preflight_daily_scans` wrapper function and promoting its individual components—such as complexity scans and auto-decomposition—to independent top-level stages. This change ensures that each scanner has its own timeout budget, preventing a single slow process from starving subsequent tasks. A new regression test suite was also introduced to verify this stage wiring. The review feedback correctly identifies that `fast_fail_prune_expired` should also be wrapped in `run_stage_with_timeout` for consistency and hang protection, and suggests corresponding updates to the new test file.

## Code Review

This pull request outlines a plan to implement a scope-guard pre-push hook to prevent unauthorized file modifications during development. The changes include defining tasks for updating the brief template, creating the hook script, integrating it into existing tools, and establishing regression tests. Review feedback focuses on specifying the data format for the new template section, incorporating path traversal protection into the hook's requirements, and adjusting the failure behavior to be stricter when a brief exists but lacks the required scope section.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a `## Files Scope` section to the agent brief template and updates `AGENTS.md` to document its role in enforcing file access restrictions via a pre-push hook. The review feedback suggests adding the new section to the worker-ready heuristic signals and formatting operational details in the template as bullet points for improved clarity.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a Files Scope section to the task brief template and documents its purpose in AGENTS.md. This field allows authors to declare allowed file paths or glob patterns, which are then enforced by the scope-guard-pre-push.sh hook to prevent accidental scope-leak. Feedback was provided to adjust heading levels for better nesting and consistency, improve the clarity of the template instructions, and ensure the documentation remains concise while providing technical justifications for restrictions.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new git pre-push hook, scope-guard-pre-push.sh, which blocks pushes if the modified files fall outside the scope defined in the task's brief. The review feedback highlights several critical improvements: ensuring compatibility with Bash 3.2 by replacing mapfile, correctly capturing exit codes from process substitutions, and refining the _compute_baseline logic to handle dynamic remote names and propagate errors. Additionally, suggestions were made to align with repository standards regarding the separation of local variable declarations from assignments.

## Code Review

This pull request adds two new task briefs to the repository's backlog and updates the `TODO.md` file. Task `t2448` outlines a plan to restrict the `ai-approved` label to repository admins via a new GitHub Actions workflow, while task `t2449` proposes extending auto-merge capabilities to maintainer-briefed worker PRs. Feedback on the `t2449` brief identified a logic bug in a bash snippet intended to detect cryptographic approvals, noting that the current implementation using `head -1` would fail to correctly identify empty results; a more efficient single-pass `jq` solution was provided as a suggestion.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a comprehensive regression test suite for the scope-guard-pre-push.sh hook, validating its behavior across several scenarios including in-scope pushes, out-of-scope blocks, and various fail-open conditions. Feedback focuses on aligning the script with project standards, specifically regarding resource cleanup using established helper functions, improving debugging visibility by removing blanket error suppression, and reducing code duplication by leveraging the invoke_hook helper.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the documentation in .agents/templates/brief-template.md to clarify the purpose of the scope-guard pre-push hook, specifically mentioning its role in preventing scope-leak during rebases or implementation drift. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the task briefs for the scope-guard pre-push hook, specifically defining the format for the file scope section and adding acceptance criteria for path traversal prevention and error handling. The review feedback suggests clarifying that relative paths must be relative to the repository root and recommends including technical reasoning and security warnings regarding path traversal risks within the documentation template.

## Code Review

This pull request improves Bash 3.2 compatibility by replacing mapfile with while-read loops and enhances the _compute_baseline function to support dynamic remotes. A review comment identifies an issue where the sed command in _compute_baseline incorrectly strips the remote prefix, which could cause git merge-base to reference local branches instead of remote-tracking ones.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the test-override-flags.sh script by adding stubs for find_project_root and detect_repo_slug and correcting test assertions to properly fail when expected conditions are not met. A review comment suggests exporting the TMP and INFO_LOG variables to ensure they are available to external scripts called by the newly added helper functions.

## Code Review

This pull request wraps the fast_fail_prune_expired function call within a run_stage_with_timeout wrapper in the pulse-dispatch-engine.sh script and updates the corresponding test assertions in test-pulse-dispatch-engine-stage-wiring.sh to reflect this change. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a repair tool, backfill-orphan-todos.sh, to identify and fix "orphan" GitHub issues that lack corresponding entries in TODO.md. It also updates claim-task-id.sh with logic to idempotently ensure TODO.md is updated whenever a new issue is created, closing the gap that caused orphans. Feedback focuses on enhancing the robustness of these scripts by supporting subtask IDs in regex patterns and using environment variables in awk commands to safely handle strings containing backslashes or special characters.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the task brief for t2449, which focuses on implementing symmetric auto-merge for maintainer-briefed origin:worker PRs. The updates include a pre-flight checklist, PR conventions, architectural decisions regarding the use of sibling functions and cryptographic approvals, task dependencies, an estimate breakdown, and a list of relevant files for implementation. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the vector search documentation by refining the sub-query planning example and adjusting the storage reduction statistics for Muvera FDE compression. Feedback was provided to address logical inconsistencies in the updated text, specifically clarifying that the storage reduction is relative to the ColBERT baseline to avoid confusion with single-vector storage costs.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the detection logic for cryptographic approval signals in GitHub issue comments by consolidating multiple API calls into a single call using jq. This change avoids potential pitfalls with exit codes from piped commands. A review comment suggests improving the robustness of the jq filter and the read command by using optional chaining and providing default values in case of API failure.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new 'Scope guard' pre-push hook designed to prevent accidental scope-leak by blocking pushes that modify files outside a task's declared scope. The `install-pre-push-guards.sh` script was refactored to support this third guard, including a new helper function `_append_guard_block` to streamline the generation of the dispatcher hook. Documentation and prompts were also updated to reflect the addition of this new guard. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request improves the `privacy-guard-pre-push.sh` hook by correctly identifying the base commit for multi-ref pushes and establishing a fallback mechanism for the default remote branch. It also updates `full-loop-helper.sh` to expose error output during `git push` operations. Feedback was provided regarding the hardcoded use of the `origin` remote, which limits flexibility, and the fallback to `HEAD` in the hook, which could inadvertently bypass privacy scans by resulting in an empty diff.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a centralized pulse lifecycle management system through the new pulse-lifecycle-helper.sh script. It automates pulse restarts during updates and setup by integrating the helper into setup.sh and aidevops-update-check.sh, ensuring that newly deployed scripts are correctly loaded into memory. The changes also include a comprehensive test suite for the lifecycle helper and updated documentation regarding these automated processes. I have no feedback to provide as there are no review comments.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the .secretlintrc.json configuration to include an allows list for the @secretlint/secretlint-rule-slack rule, permitting specific Slack token patterns. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a repository-wide check for task ID claims in the task-id-collision-guard hook, enabling cross-references to task IDs from previously merged PRs. The feedback focuses on optimizing the new `_repo_has_claim` function by reducing redundant git log calls and using internal filtering for better performance. Additionally, a correction was suggested for an accidental credential redaction that corrupted a string in the test suite output.

## Code Review

This pull request extends the GitHub CLI wrapper's REST fallback mechanism to include Pull Request creation, ensuring that `gh pr create` remains functional even when the GraphQL API is exhausted. The implementation includes a new `_gh_pr_create_rest` helper that handles argument parsing, body files, and label application via the REST API, along with comprehensive regression tests. The review feedback suggests several improvements: dynamically determining the default base branch instead of hardcoding 'main', adding support for assignees and milestones to achieve better parity with the native command, and refining the parsing of API responses to use direct JSON fields rather than regex for better robustness.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors `aidevops.sh` by extracting initialization, repository management, and skill/plugin logic into separate sub-libraries to maintain a manageable file size. The review feedback highlights several technical improvements, including generalizing repository slug extraction for multi-provider support and replacing `eval` with direct assignments to enhance security. The reviewer also suggested optimizing JSON parsing with `jq` to handle null values more cleanly and adding validation for command-line arguments to prevent script crashes when flags are missing values.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the aidevops.sh orchestrator by modularizing its logic into three new sub-libraries: aidevops-repos.sh, aidevops-init.sh, and aidevops-plugins.sh. This change significantly reduces the main script's complexity and improves overall maintainability. The review feedback suggests enhancing the robustness of CLI argument parsing in the plugin library, optimizing multi-line file generation using command groups instead of string concatenation, and refactoring the excessively long cmd_init function into smaller, single-purpose helper functions.

## Code Review

This pull request replaces Bash-specific namerefs with module-level globals in `shared-gh-wrappers.sh` to ensure compatibility with Zsh and older Bash versions, and introduces a new Zsh compatibility test suite. The review feedback points out that the extraction logic still uses `BASH_REMATCH`, which is not portable to Zsh, and recommends using parameter expansion instead. Additionally, the new test suite should be expanded to cover all title-based extraction paths to ensure full validation.

## Code Review

This pull request broadens the trust model for quality-debt issues by allowing admin and maintain collaborators to skip the NMR (Needs Maintainer Review) approval gate. It introduces a two-stage check involving a local configuration fast-path and a GitHub API permission probe, and extends the automation signature detector to recognize source:review-feedback markers. Comprehensive tests for the new trust logic and signature detection are included. The review feedback suggests improving script robustness by using parameterized jq arguments to prevent injection and handling potential duplicate configuration entries.

## Code Review

This pull request implements a multi-layered signature footer enforcement system for GitHub CLI write commands, including a new PATH shim and enhanced validation hooks in quality-hooks.mjs. The changes provide automatic repair of missing signatures and mentoring error messages for unparseable commands. Review feedback identified critical command injection vulnerabilities in the repair logic, regex limitations for file paths containing spaces, and potential path traversal risks.

## Code Review

This pull request addresses duplicate health-dashboard issues caused by GraphQL rate-limit windows. It introduces robust error handling in `_find_health_issue` to prevent duplicate creation during API failures, adds a periodic dedup scan to clean up existing duplicates, and includes a one-shot migration script to resolve current issues. The review feedback suggests performance improvements, such as using `--paginate` for API calls, consolidating `jq` processing, and using safer variable passing in `jq` filters.

## Code Review

This pull request implements a comprehensive privacy scrub by replacing private repository references with the generic placeholder 'webapp' across scripts, tests, and documentation. Review feedback identifies a task status inconsistency in TODO.md and recommends maintaining full URL structures in test mocks to preserve data realism and robustness.

## Code Review

This pull request fixes a bug where re-exported identifiers were used locally without an explicit import, leading to ReferenceErrors. The fix is applied to google-proxy.mjs and quality-hooks.mjs, and a new regression test is added to detect similar issues. Review feedback correctly identifies a factual error in a code comment, logic flaws in the test's parsing of import aliases and regex handling of trailing comments, and the need to escape identifiers used in dynamic regular expressions to prevent matching errors.

## Code Review

This pull request removes the unsupported headRefName field from gh search prs calls in .agents/scripts/pulse-batch-prefetch-helper.sh, as the GitHub Search API returns issue-shaped results that do not include this field. The script now includes comments explaining that branch names must be fetched lazily via gh pr view if required. Additionally, a new task brief document todo/tasks/t2695-brief.md has been added to track this change. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request replaces a hardcoded list of plugin files with dynamic discovery using readdirSync in the re-export regression test. Review feedback recommends marking the associated task as completed in TODO.md while keeping the entry concise. Furthermore, the verification commands in the task brief should use relative paths instead of hardcoded absolute paths to improve portability.

## Code Review

This pull request adds two new tasks to the TODO.md file: one to fix a missing visibility check in the CI/CD workflow and another to enhance the issue synchronization script to automatically seed orphan GitHub issues into the task list. Feedback was provided to remove fragile line number references from the task descriptions to prevent maintenance overhead and to maintain consistency in task identifier formats by avoiding the use of GitHub issue numbers as primary task prefixes.

## Code Review

This pull request increases the timeout for the canary wrapper script from 30 to 60 seconds in the test suite. Feedback suggests separating local variable declarations from command substitution assignments to ensure exit code safety under 'set -e', as well as consolidating repeated executions to improve performance and reliability.

## Code Review

This pull request implements REST API fallback for GitHub issue read operations (view and list) to ensure reliability when GraphQL quotas are exhausted. It introduces _rest_issue_view and _rest_issue_list functions, along with their corresponding wrappers gh_issue_view and gh_issue_list, and updates several scripts to utilize these new wrappers. A comprehensive regression test suite is also included. The review feedback identifies a need for URL-encoding query parameters, specifically labels and assignees, within the _rest_issue_list function to prevent issues with special characters.

## Code Review

This pull request updates two shell scripts to remove the 'persistent' label from duplicate health issues before closing them, preventing automated sync jobs from reopening them. The review feedback suggests removing a redundant stderr redirection in the migration script and refactoring the duplicated label-removal logic in the dashboard script into a reusable helper function to improve maintainability.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces three wrapper scripts in .agents/bin/ to fix execution failures for routines r902, r906, and r910 caused by spaces in command paths. The routine definitions in core-routines.sh were updated to point to these wrappers, alongside corresponding documentation and test updates. Feedback points out that other routines (r903, r904, r907, r908, r909) likely suffer from the same issue and should be updated. Additionally, the PATH prepending logic in the new wrappers should be modified to avoid potential security risks from a trailing colon if the PATH variable is empty.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a safety guard in `worktree-helper.sh` to prevent the creation of git worktrees inside the repository's own working tree, which helps avoid git state confusion and cleanup hazards. The implementation includes a new path resolution utility and a validation function, supported by a comprehensive regression test suite. Feedback is provided to improve the robustness of path normalization, specifically to avoid double slashes when resolving from the root directory and to ensure consistent symlink resolution using `pwd -P`.

## Code Review

This pull request replaces the sentinel-based script drift detection with a more comprehensive check against the `.deployed-sha` stamp in `aidevops.sh` and `auto-update-helper.sh`, accompanied by a new regression test suite. Feedback focuses on expanding the list of monitored framework paths to include critical files like `setup.sh` and using a more reliable `grep -q .` pattern to detect git diff output consistently across all implementations.

## Code Review

This pull request disables the 'Dashboard server' routine (r912) in the core-routines.sh configuration file by removing the activation flag. I have no feedback to provide as there were no review comments.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a local fingerprinting mechanism to prevent duplicate GitHub issue filings, specifically addressing the race condition caused by GitHub's search indexing lag. It adds a helper script for computing issue hashes and managing a local state file, and updates the workflow documentation to mandate these checks. The review feedback focuses on optimizing the fingerprint lookup efficiency in the shell script, preventing hash collisions by using delimiters, and ensuring the integrity of the state file through input validation.

## Code Review

This pull request ensures that health dashboard issues are created with the 'origin:worker' label by forcing the AIDEVOPS_SESSION_ORIGIN environment variable within the _create_health_issue function. It also includes a new regression test suite to verify this behavior and environment variable restoration. Feedback was provided to simplify the manual save-and-restore logic for the environment variable by using a more idiomatic single-command override, which also improves exit code safety by separating the local variable declaration from its assignment.

## Code Review

This pull request enhances the issue synchronization process by automatically seeding `TODO.md` entries for "orphan" GitHub issues—open issues that possess a task ID but lack a corresponding entry in the local TODO file. The changes include new helper functions in `issue-sync-lib.sh` for formatting and inserting these entries, updates to `issue-sync-helper.sh` to track and report seeding progress, and a new test suite for verification. Review feedback focuses on improving the robustness of the implementation by making the task ID prefix stripping more flexible and utilizing `jq` for reliable label detection within JSON data.

## Code Review

This pull request enhances the `_gh_pr_create_rest` function by adding auto-detection for the `--head` and `--base` parameters, aligning its behavior with the standard `gh` CLI. The `--head` is derived from the current branch, and the `--base` is determined via the GitHub API or local git metadata. New tests were included to validate these detection paths. A review comment suggested improving the `jq` parsing logic to handle `null` values and maintaining error visibility for better debugging.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a proactive GraphQL rate-limit circuit breaker to prevent worker dispatch when GitHub's API budget is nearly exhausted. It adds a new utility script, `pulse-rate-limit-circuit-breaker.sh`, which monitors the GraphQL quota and provides a mechanism to pause the dispatch engine. The implementation includes integration into the `pulse-dispatch-engine.sh` capacity logic, configuration via environment variables, and a comprehensive test suite. Feedback focuses on improving error visibility by removing stderr suppression in `jq` commands and standardizing fallback value patterns for consistency.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the staleness check for prompt guard patterns in `security-posture-helper.sh` by implementing a three-level fallback chain (deployment stamp, git commit date, and file mtime). This change addresses issues where `rsync` preserves original file timestamps during deployment, leading to false staleness reports. A new test script is also added to verify the fallback logic. Review feedback suggests improving the script's portability by avoiding hardcoded repository paths and increasing robustness by using shell parameter expansion for arithmetic operations.

## Code Review

This pull request extends the signature-footer injection to `gh api` raw REST calls and REST fallback translators to ensure all GitHub writes include the audit marker. The feedback highlights that the endpoint detection regexes are too restrictive, missing several PATCH scenarios and query parameter handling. Additionally, the argument parsing logic in the `gh` shim needs to be more robust to handle long-form flags like `--field` and `--raw-field`, as well as various flag-value assignment syntaxes.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces automatic detection for the --head and --base arguments in the _gh_pr_create_rest function when they are omitted. It adds helper functions to resolve the current git branch for the head and the repository's default branch for the base, utilizing the GitHub REST API and local git references. Corresponding unit tests were added to verify these auto-detection mechanisms. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces automated seeding of TODO.md entries for open orphan GitHub issues during the synchronization process. Key additions include logic to fetch issue labels, map them to tags, and append new tasks to the TODO file, supported by a new regression test suite. Review feedback focuses on code cleanup and clarity, specifically recommending the removal of a redundant string comparison, the simplification of a tag formatting pipeline, and the correction of a misleading comment in the test file.

## Code Review

This pull request refines the escalation logic for `origin:interactive` pull requests in the `pulse-dirty-pr-sweep.sh` script. It introduces a new function, `_dps_pr_body_has_issue_reference`, to detect issue references within PR bodies, allowing these PRs to follow standard age-based closing heuristics rather than immediate escalation. The update also includes corresponding changes to PR data fetching and a suite of new test cases. Feedback was provided to improve the robustness of the regex used for issue detection by incorporating word boundaries and POSIX character classes to prevent false positives.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the documentation in AGENTS.md to reflect that the #auto-dispatch tag now correctly skips self-assignment across all three issue-creation paths, including claim-task-id.sh. It also updates the workaround log and marks task t2218 as completed in TODO.md. Review feedback suggests using more inclusive terminology like 'creator' instead of 'pusher' in the documentation and updating the specific test file reference in the TODO.md entry for historical accuracy.

## Code Review

This pull request enhances cross-shell compatibility for shared-gh-wrappers.sh by implementing a robust directory resolution logic that supports both Bash and Zsh. Additionally, a new test script test-shared-gh-wrappers-source.sh is introduced to verify correct sourcing and helper definition across shells. Review feedback suggests improving the robustness of directory navigation by using cd -- with a ./ prefix and avoiding the use of 2>/dev/null for error suppression to maintain visibility of potential system issues.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the `_labels_json_to_tags` function in `issue-sync-lib.sh` by simplifying the input validation logic and utilizing `paste` for cleaner tag formatting. It also includes a minor update to a test case comment in `test-issue-sync-pull-seeds-orphans.sh`. I have no feedback to provide as there were no review comments to evaluate.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the simplification state configuration and expands the SonarCloud exclusion list for shell scripts to ignore specific rules regarding unused variables, collapsible if statements, and function naming conventions. Feedback suggests consolidating the new exclusion criteria by grouping related rule keys into single entries to improve the maintainability and conciseness of the configuration file.

## Code Review

This pull request significantly expands the task brief for t2732, transforming it into a detailed inventory and classification report for 293 SonarCloud findings (S1481, S1066, and S100) within shell scripts. The document now includes an executive summary, pattern taxonomies, detailed findings tables, and specific recommendations for global exclusions and residual cleanup. Feedback was provided regarding a numerical discrepancy between the aggregate summary counts and the detailed findings for rule S1481, along with a suggestion to move the extensive data tables to a separate reference file to maintain a concise core brief in accordance with tiered documentation standards.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the simplification state and adds a new documentation file, docs/sonar-exemptions.md, to track SonarCloud rule suppressions. The review feedback points out that the documentation lists several exclusions not yet implemented in the project configuration and provides a technical correction for the rationale regarding shell variable assignments and error handling.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces the hold-for-review label to the pulse-dirty-pr-sweep.sh script, ensuring that PRs with this label are excluded from automatic closing. The review feedback identifies that while the label prevents auto-closing, it should also be used to prevent automated rebasing to align with the safety gate documentation. It is recommended to delegate this check to the _dps_consider_rebase helper to avoid logic duplication and ensure consistent behavior.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces an extended 14-day closure window for origin:interactive pull requests that contain issue references, preventing them from being automatically closed by the standard 7-day heuristic. It updates the pulse-dirty-pr-sweep.sh script with the new DIRTY_PR_CLOSE_MIN_AGE_INTERACTIVE variable and logic, adds comprehensive test cases to verify the behavior across different PR types and ages, and updates the simplification state configuration. I have no feedback to provide.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the simplification state configuration with new reference documents and refines the pulse-dirty-pr-sweep.sh script to expand the definition of planning-only conflicts to include README.md and the todo/ directory. A review comment suggests optimizing the grep pipeline in the shell script for better readability and POSIX portability by using a single grep -vE command and replacing \s with [[:space:]].

## Code Review

This pull request implements a two-tier age gate for PR rebasing, extending the eligibility window for planning-only conflicts to 7 days while keeping a 48-hour limit for code conflicts. It also updates state configurations for several reference documents. Review feedback points out that the implementation currently lacks a rebase path for code conflicts despite defining a timeout for them, creating an inconsistency in the logic and documentation. Additionally, it is recommended to move the age check before expensive git operations to improve script efficiency.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a two-tier age gate for PR rebasing in the pulse-dirty-pr-sweep.sh script. It distinguishes between planning-only conflicts (e.g., TODO.md, README.md) and code conflicts, extending the rebase eligibility window for planning files to 7 days while maintaining a 48-hour limit for code changes. Review feedback recommends optimizing performance by performing age checks before executing expensive conflict detection and suggests dynamically determining the base branch to improve script robustness.

## Code Review

This pull request streamlines the OpenCode session greeting by updating the generate-runtime-config.sh script to use a cached one-liner and avoid redundant update checks.
